months.thought_at_decision: The offer from X company is to buy both the land and the building of my house on Hatoba-dori, with the condition that I can continue to use it. This is an attractive offer, as it allows me to remain in my home while transferring ownership. However, my deep attachment to this house, filled with memories, makes me hesitant to part with ownership. The offer lacks a specific monetary value, which is also a concern. I've discussed this with the owner of Hamacho Ryokan, and he also decided to pass on a similar proposal due to the lack of a price. I share his sentiment. Therefore, I will decline this offer and will not put my property up for sale myself. My home is too precious to sell.
